doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Venuti, Billie Rogers and Henry Jerome
title: The lost draft card
summary: Mandel says the draft board lost his registration and he never heard from them again.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: So by the time the war ended you were almost twenty, right?
So you avoided, they didn’t call you up?

Yep. They lost it, I wish we lived in that, well, you say you wish you lived in that pre­ computer age now, something like that, they can still lose stuff on computers but then they really lost it, ‘cause I was sweating it out. I just never heard from them again after I registered.
